items.title: PayPal leaves the door open to a higher takeover offer following earnings beat
items.summary: After reporting better-than-expected Q2 results, PayPal said it remains focused on its AI-driven turnaround, but would consider a deal that creates more value for shareholders.

items.title: Elon Musk’s X Money app is rolling out in the U.S.
items.summary: The app is currently available to X Premium and Premium+ subscribers in the U.S.

items.title: WhatsApp now lets you make calls using its web app
items.summary: Similar to the smartphone and desktop apps, the web app will support the calling features such as screen-sharing and reactions.

items.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
items.summary: Since launching last year, the startup today has more than 8 million people using the open-source or hosted version of its models, and now generates annual recurring revenue of $21 million.

items.title: Apple launches ‘Upgrade’ device leasing program in partnership with Klarna
items.summary: Leasing prices start at $17.99 per month for iPhone, $11.99 for Apple Watch, $24.99 for Mac, and $11.99 for iPad.

items.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 compute deal with Amazon
items.summary: Recursive’s $400 million outlay represents the bulk of the company’s fundraising to date.

items.title: Granola launches an Apple Watch app
items.summary: Granola debutes an Apple Watch app for in-person notetaking

items.title: Lyft and Baidu enter London’s robotaxi battleground as testing begins
items.summary: Baidu's Apollo Go autonomous vehicles will be available on Freenow, the mobility network that Lyft acquired in 2025.

items.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
items.summary: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
items.summary: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

items.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
items.summary: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.

items.title: Thea Energy lands $20M federal grant to build its magnets for fusion reactors
items.summary: Fusion power startup Thea Energy snagged a $20 million award from ARPA-E to scale production of its high-temperature superconducting magnets.

items.title: As rivals chase acquisitions, Peacock bets on bundles through a new deal with YouTube
items.summary: The deal means content will be integrated into the YouTube experience, allowing viewers to discover and watch Peacock content without leaving the platform.

items.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
items.summary: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.

items.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
items.summary: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.

items.title: Apple sued after alleged App Store crypto scam cost users $1.8M
items.summary: Apple is facing a lawsuit from three users who say they collectively lost more than $1.8 million after downloading a fraudulent crypto wallet from the App Store, challenging the company’s longstanding...

items.title: Amazon’s new satellite network for mobile phones could turn up the heat on SpaceX
items.summary: Amazon is expanding its plans for providing satellite connectivity to mobile phones.

items.title: Antares raises $470M to build nuclear reactors for the US military
items.summary: Antares has raised $470 million to build small modular reactors — 100 kW to 1 MW — for U.S. Air Force bases.

items.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
items.summary: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.

items.title: Threads users can now chat with Meta AI in their DMs
items.summary: Meta on Monday said it is rolling out its Meta AI chatbot within Threads' DMs, giving users a way to chat with the AI assistant.
